answer: Context-Chained Witness Log. Each identity must append a unique record derived from the prior block’s physical sensor trace, like wind variance over a tundra, so replays fail hash checks. A new identity costs one distinct hardware attestation plus a live environmental sample, such as soil moisture from a mesa. Duplicates are rejected before admission. Forgery requires per-identity device fabrication and captured lotus-scale microclimate data, making mass sybils economically heavier than honest participation.
